\section[huṣāru]{\kn{ಹುಷಾರು} (huṣāru) — take care, careful}

\label{lesson:KA-C89-takecare}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for come in, then the Kannada for welcome.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಹುಷಾರು}}
\textbf{\kn{ಹುಷಾರು}} (\emph{huṣāru}) — \textquotedblleft{}careful, take care\textquotedblright{}. Said at parting it means \textquotedblleft{}look after yourself\textquotedblright{}; said on its own it can also mean \textquotedblleft{}well again\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
A warm word at the door.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{huṣāru}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{huṣāru}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{huṣāru!}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for come in, then the Kannada for welcome, then say \emph{huṣāru} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ಹುಷಾರು} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Take care, careful\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[jōpāna]{\kn{ಜೋಪಾನ} (jōpāna) — carefully, safely}

\label{lesson:KA-C89-safely}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for welcome, then the Kannada for take care.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಜೋಪಾನ}}
\textbf{\kn{ಜೋಪಾನ}} (\emph{jōpāna}) — \textquotedblleft{}carefully, safely\textquotedblright{}.

\textbf{\kn{ಜೋಪಾನವಾಗಿ} \kn{ಹೋಗಿ}} (\emph{jōpānavāgi hōgi}) — \textquotedblleft{}go safely\textquotedblright{}, with the same \textbf{‑\kn{ಆಗಿ}} ending as \textbf{\kn{ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ}}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The second half of a caring goodbye.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{jōpāna}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{jōpāna}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{jōpānavāgi hōgi}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for welcome, then the Kannada for take care, then say \emph{jōpāna} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ಜೋಪಾನ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Carefully, safely\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[taḍavāyitu]{\kn{ತಡವಾಯಿತು} (taḍavāyitu) — it's late, it got late}

\label{lesson:KA-C89-late}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for take care, then the Kannada for safely.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ತಡವಾಯಿತು}}
\textbf{\kn{ತಡವಾಯಿತು}} (\emph{taḍavāyitu}) — \textquotedblleft{}it's late\textquotedblright{}, literally \textquotedblleft{}it has become late\textquotedblright{}. \textbf{\kn{ತಡ}} (\emph{taḍa}) is \textquotedblleft{}delay, lateness\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The reason people stand up to leave.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{taḍavāyitu}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{taḍavāyitu}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{taḍavāyitu}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for take care, then the Kannada for safely, then say \emph{taḍavāyitu} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ತಡವಾಯಿತು} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}It's late, it got late\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[hōgōṇa]{\kn{ಹೋಗೋಣ} (hōgōṇa) — let's go}

\label{lesson:KA-C89-letsgo}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for safely, then the Kannada for it's late.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಹೋಗೋಣ}}
\textbf{\kn{ಹೋಗೋಣ}} (\emph{hōgōṇa}) — \textquotedblleft{}let's go\textquotedblright{}. The ending \textbf{‑\kn{ಓಣ}} (\emph{-ōṇa}) means \textquotedblleft{}let's\textquotedblright{}, the same one you know from \textbf{\kn{ಸಿಗೋಣ}} (\emph{sigōṇa}), \textquotedblleft{}let's meet\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
A known ending on a known verb.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{hōgōṇa}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{hōgōṇa}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{taḍavāyitu, hōgōṇa}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for safely, then the Kannada for it's late, then say \emph{hōgōṇa} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ಹೋಗೋಣ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Let's go\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[raje]{\kn{ರಜೆ} (raje) — a holiday, leave}

\label{lesson:KA-C89-holiday}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for it's late, then the Kannada for let's go.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ರಜೆ}}
\textbf{\kn{ರಜೆ}} (\emph{raje}) — \textquotedblleft{}a holiday, time off\textquotedblright{}.

\textbf{\kn{ನಾಳೆ} \kn{ರಜೆ}} (\emph{nāḷe raje}) — \textquotedblleft{}tomorrow is a holiday\textquotedblright{}, with \textbf{\kn{ನಾಳೆ}}, \textquotedblleft{}tomorrow\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
A good reason to say goodbye cheerfully.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{raje}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{raje}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{nāḷe raje}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for it's late, then the Kannada for let's go, then say \emph{raje} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ರಜೆ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A holiday, leave\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{How are you, really? — a first pass}

\label{lesson:KA-R89-first-pass-unwell-feelings}



\begin{quote}
Tomorrow is a holiday, and it is time to go. Say both.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item you are tired, you have a cold, a cough and a headache
  \item tell a friend to take rest
  \item name sadness, worry, fear, anger and laughter
  \item you are thirsty and worn out; ask where the hospital is; ask for a tablet
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Tiredness? (\textbf{\kn{ಆಯಾಸ}}.) A cold? (\textbf{\kn{ಶೀತ}}.) A cough? (\textbf{\kn{ಕೆಮ್ಮು}}.) A headache? (\textbf{\kn{ತಲೆನೋವು}}.) Rest? (\textbf{\kn{ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ}}.) Sadness, worry, fear, anger, laughter? (\textbf{\kn{ದುಃಖ}, \kn{ಚಿಂತೆ}, \kn{ಭಯ}, \kn{ಕೋಪ}, \kn{ನಗು}}.) Thirst? (\textbf{\kn{ಬಾಯಾರಿಕೆ}}.) Worn out? (\textbf{\kn{ಸುಸ್ತು}}.) Sweat? (\textbf{\kn{ಬೆವರು}}.) Hospital? (\textbf{\kn{ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆ}}.) A tablet? (\textbf{\kn{ಮಾತ್ರೆ}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Talking it through — a second pass}

\label{lesson:KA-R89-second-pass-repair-replies-welcome}



\begin{quote}
Someone speaks too fast. Ask them to speak slowly, and to say it once more.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a little louder; what is the meaning of this?; please write it down
  \item one minute; please wait; please show me the way
  \item I didn't hear; I didn't understand
  \item really?; nothing; oh no!; is that so?; that's the one!
  \item congratulations; an invitation for you; a gift for you; please come in; welcome
  \item take care; go safely; it's late; let's go; tomorrow is a holiday
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Slowly? (\textbf{\kn{ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ}}.) Once more? (\textbf{\kn{ಮತ್ತೊಮ್ಮೆ}}.) Loudly? (\textbf{\kn{ಜೋರಾಗಿ}}.) Meaning? (\textbf{\kn{ಅರ್ಥ}}.) Write it down? (\textbf{\kn{ಬರೆದು} \kn{ಕೊಡಿ}}.) One minute? (\textbf{\kn{ಒಂದು} \kn{ನಿಮಿಷ}}.) Please wait? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಾಯಿರಿ}}.) Show me? (\textbf{\kn{ತೋರಿಸಿ}}.) I didn't hear? (\textbf{\kn{ಕೇಳಿಸಲಿಲ್ಲ}}.) I didn't understand? (\textbf{\kn{ಅರ್ಥವಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ}}.) Really? (\textbf{\kn{ನಿಜವಾಗಲೂ}?}) Nothing? (\textbf{\kn{ಏನೂ} \kn{ಇಲ್ಲ}}.) Oh no? (\textbf{\kn{ಅಯ್ಯೋ}}.) Is that so? (\textbf{\kn{ಹೌದಾ}?}) The same? (\textbf{\kn{ಅದೇ}}.) Congratulations? (\textbf{\kn{ಅಭಿನಂದನೆಗಳು}}.) Invitation? (\textbf{\kn{ಆಹ್ವಾನ}}.) Gift? (\textbf{\kn{ಉಡುಗೊರೆ}}.) Come in? (\textbf{\kn{ಒಳಗೆ} \kn{ಬನ್ನಿ}}.) Welcome? (\textbf{\kn{ಸ್ವಾಗತ}}.) Take care? (\textbf{\kn{ಹುಷಾರು}}.) Safely? (\textbf{\kn{ಜೋಪಾನ}}.) It's late? (\textbf{\kn{ತಡವಾಯಿತು}}.) Let's go? (\textbf{\kn{ಹೋಗೋಣ}}.) Holiday? (\textbf{\kn{ರಜೆ}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
